Engine-reported protein-level column names

Source: R/prot-all.R
diann_protein_columns.Rd

The DIA-NN protein- and gene-level quantity and q-value columns that parse_diann() passes through, listed in one place so the loader's dplyr::any_of() selection and prot_engine_columns() cannot drift apart.

Usage

diann_protein_columns()

Value

A character vector of column names.

Details

Both DIA-NN naming generations are included — the fields were renamed between releases (PG.Quantity became PG.Abundance, PG.Normalised became PG.NormalisedAbundance) — so whichever spelling a report carries is kept.

Examples

diann_protein_columns()
#>  [1] "PG.Quantity"               "PG.Normalised"            
#>  [3] "PG.MaxLFQ"                 "PG.Abundance"             
#>  [5] "PG.NormalisedAbundance"    "PG.NormalizedAbundance"   
#>  [7] "Genes.Quantity"            "Genes.Normalised"         
#>  [9] "Genes.MaxLFQ"              "Genes.MaxLFQ.Unique"      
#> [11] "Genes.Abundance"           "Genes.NormalisedAbundance"
#> [13] "Protein.Q.Value"           "PG.Q.Value"               
#> [15] "Global.PG.Q.Value"         "GG.Q.Value"               
#> [17] "Lib.PG.Q.Value"
